distribution: not bundled; downloaded only after an explicit user action, cached under <dataDir>/ocr-tessdata/langs/
notes: Language data is not included in the source repository, app.asar, or the NSIS installer.
The official raw URL and the GitHub Contents API both point to the same repository and file.
No third-party mirror is used as a default download source.
The download is initiated only by an explicit user action; Studianda does not redistribute the traineddata files.
Per-language file SHA-256 values are not recorded here; the license text hash is recorded above.
Language data versions are not pinned (the upstream repository updates models over time).

Before installing, the app requests the GitHub Contents API metadata (size and git blob sha) for the same file and compares it with the downloaded bytes when metadata is reachable; otherwise it falls back to a >100KB size check. No static per-language SHA-256 list is maintained.
